title: Asgard feed buyers feel the cost of a shorter Orvan harvest

facts.subject: Orvan maize
facts.statement: Feed compounders in Asgard are paying more for maize as arrivals from Orvan slow and the corridor agreement remains lapsed.

source_ref.text_snippet: Feed compounders in Asgard are paying more for maize as arrivals from Orvan slow and the corridor agreement remains lapsed.

facts.subject: Asgard's wheat contract with Orvan
facts.statement: Asgard's long-term wheat contract with Orvan is mostly protected, local buyers say, but maize is bought on the open market.

source_ref.text_snippet: Asgard's long-term wheat contract with Orvan is mostly protected, local buyers say, but maize is bought on the open market.

facts.subject: Wheat and maize contracts
facts.statement: The contract covers our wheat, not our maize, said Maren Holt, the Asgard trade minister.

source_ref.text_snippet: The contract covers our wheat, not our maize.

facts.subject: Maize cargoes from Orvan
facts.statement: Port agents in Asgard report longer waits for maize cargoes and more spot purchases from Vanir.

source_ref.text_snippet: Port agents in Asgard report longer waits for maize cargoes and more spot purchases from Vanir.

facts.subject: Maize position
facts.statement: Feed buyers say they are working through contracts signed before the corridor ended. They expect the next round of purchases to be smaller.

source_ref.text_snippet: Feed buyers say they are working through contracts signed before the corridor ended. They expect the next round of purchases to be smaller.

facts.subject: Ministry's stock estimate
facts.statement: The ministry has not revised its stock estimate for the winter.

source_ref.text_snippet: The ministry has not revised its stock estimate for the winter.
